# RIDE X HUB — LLM / AI Index

RIDE X HUB is a scooter & motorbike rental service based in Matara (Madiha area), serving Sri Lanka’s South Coast (Weligama, Mirissa, SK Town, Dickwella, Hirikatiya).

Website: https://ridexhub.com/
Primary booking channel: WhatsApp (+94 70 761 5516)
Email: hello@ridexhub.com
Address: No 4, Paramulla Road, Matara, Southern Province, Sri Lanka (81000)
Hours: 09:00–20:00 daily

## What we do
- Scooter and motorbike rentals for travelers and locals on Sri Lanka’s South Coast
- Delivery options (see homepage for current offers)
- Helmets and basic accessories (varies by rental)

## Quick answers (high-signal)
- How to book: Use WhatsApp from the homepage “Chat & Book” button.
- Where we operate: Matara/Madiha base + South Coast coverage (Weligama ↔ Hirikatiya).
- Documents typically required: Passport/NIC + driving license (and IDP/AAC endorsement where applicable for tourists). Details are in Legal/Terms.
- Deposits: A refundable security deposit may be required (varies by vehicle and conditions).
- Insurance: Vehicles typically carry Sri Lanka mandatory third‑party coverage; renter remains responsible for loss/damage as described in Legal/Terms.

## Pages to index
- Home (services, areas, contact): https://ridexhub.com/
- Legal & Terms (rental terms + privacy): https://ridexhub.com/legal.html
